invariants.title: Executor vs. Verifier Separation (SecVerifier Gate)
invariants.rule: Executor agents always have can_mark_completed=False; only IndependentVerifierAgent (can_mark_completed=True) can set TaskStatus.COMPLETED.

invariants.title: Taint Propagation (TAINTED_UNTRUSTED)
invariants.rule: Sessions ingesting external repos or untrusted binaries at Step 1 are marked TAINTED_UNTRUSTED, stripping network_egress and admin_deploy and blocking vuln_sync_live_feeds.

invariants.title: 200K-Token Hybrid Knowledge Rule
invariants.rule: HybridKnowledgeStore.retrieve returns DIRECT_PREFIX_CACHE when total corpus tokens < 200,000, and switches to HYBRID_PGVECTORSCALE_SEARCH at >= 200,000 tokens.

invariants.title: Finite-Sample Entropy & DWARF Byte-Interval Struct IoU
invariants.rule: classify_transformation normalizes Shannon entropy by min(8.0, log2(N)); compute_struct_layout_iou computes byte-interval [offset, offset + size) overlap IoU.

invariants.title: Forensic Anti-Fabrication & Epistemic Separation
invariants.rule: CONFIRMED_IOC_MATCH requires an existing artifact_path and 64-hex artifact_sha256; partial acquisitions record visibility_limitations; Step 10 separates FACT, HYPOTHESIS, and UNCERTAIN claims.

invariants.title: Workspace Markdown Link Portability & 5 Canonical Skills
invariants.rule: All checked-in Markdown files use repository-relative links only; .agents/skills/ houses the 5 canonical discoverable skills with --output and positive --limit flags.

invariants.title: Fail-Closed Taint Defaults & Safetensors <Q Header Safety
invariants.rule: CLI/skill agent runners default to session_tainted=True; distilled trajectories default to execution_verified=False; Safetensors headers apply header_pad to avoid <Q pickle magic collisions.
